name: LWGA
title: Association under the Israeli Model Bylaws

1(a).mapped_to: founding: the founder is the first member
1(a).question: The app has no registrar. Does the association also register with the Registrar of Amutot?

1(b).mapped_to: joining is an act of the applicant, who thereby undertakes the contract

1(c).mapped_to: act: admit a member, decided by the committee rule; on appeal, the same act decided by the meeting rule
1(c).question: An appeal against a refusal goes to the general meeting. Build it as a second vote by the members?

2(a).mapped_to: weight: one vote each; any member may be elected to the committee

2(c).question: Dues need coins. In which coins are dues paid, and does the committee's decision need the members' vote each time?

3(a).mapped_to: act: leave, by the member alone; act: expel
3(a).question: Leaving takes effect at once in the app; the bylaws ask 30 days' notice. Who records a member's death?

3(b).mapped_to: act: expel; decided by the meeting rule
3(b).question: The meeting may expel only on the committee's proposal and for four grounds. Who attests the ground, and must a committee member move the motion?

3(c).question: How is the member heard: a written response shown to all before the vote, or a live hearing?

4.mapped_to: absorbed: the app delivers every motion to every member (inclusion)

5.mapped_to: absorbed: there is no time or place

6.mapped_to: notice becomes a period: a motion of the members can be decided only ten days or more after it was moved (inclusion)
6.question: Ten days' notice: should a motion stay open for at least ten days before it can be decided?

7.mapped_to: act: elect a member to the committee; decided by the meeting rule
7.question: The audit committee is not built. Reports to the meeting are an undertaking of the committee?

8(a).mapped_to: quorum in ballots: a quarter of the members must vote
8(a).question: Preset used: quorum in ballots. The bylaws count those present at the opening; here it is those who voted. Agreed?

8(b).question: If a motion fails for lack of quorum, may it be moved again with no quorum, as the adjourned meeting allows?

9.mapped_to: absorbed: the app orders the procedure; no chair or secretary of a meeting

10.mapped_to: meeting rule: more than half of the votes cast
10.question: The chair may break a tie. With no chair, a tie fails. Agreed?

11.mapped_to: absorbed: the app records every act

12.question: At least two committee members: enforce, or leave to the members?

13(a).mapped_to: act: remove from the committee, by the meeting rule; no fixed term

13(b).mapped_to: act: resign a role, by the committee member alone
13(b).question: Who records a court order that ends a committee member's office?

14(a).mapped_to: act: appoint to the committee, decided by the committee rule
14(a).question: Build co-option by the committee, or leave elections to the members only? (The bylaws limit it to a vacancy and until the next meeting; neither limit is built.)

14(b).mapped_to: substitute for an absent committee member

16.mapped_to: committee rule: more than half of the votes cast; a tie fails

17.mapped_to: absorbed: the app records every act

18.mapped_to: signing for the association by two committee members
18.question: Which acts need two signers?

20.mapped_to: branches: an organization may found another

21.question: State the transfer of surplus assets as an undertaking of the members?

coop_join_appeal.clause: Appeal: Bob becomes a member of Orga also by an act of Bob and the members.

coop_board_fill.clause: Filling a seat: the committee members appoint a member to the committee.

definition: An association is a cooperative with two roles, member, held by every participant, and committee member; the committee members decide the admission of a member when {committee}; the members decide every other act of the association when {meeting}.
names: Alice and Bob are persons, Orga an association.
clauses: ■ Founding.  Alice may found Orga and become its first member.
■ Admission.  Bob becomes a member of Orga by an act of Bob and the committee members.
■ Voting against.  A member or a committee member may vote against a proposed act of Orga, once, in place of voting for it.
■ Appeal.  Bob becomes a member of Orga also by an act of Bob and the members.
■ Filling a seat.  The committee members may appoint a member to the committee.
